reportSeeds.description: Parent-record report using built-in identification and custom property fields. Optional name search narrows the division-scoped property list.

One row per market-value observation, with parent property fields. Required dates select observations in a range; this does not select only the latest valuation. Amount and currency remain separate columns.
One row per saved measurement period. Demonstrates parent columns, exact decimal quantities, reference IDs and period columns. All saved periods are shown; no effective-on-date rule is implied.
Child-collection report with parent customer identification. A permanent not-blank email filter combines with an optional contact-role search. Customers with no contact rows are absent.

reportSeeds.report_name: Example: Approved transaction lines by date
reportSeeds.description: Flat financial detail at line grain. A permanent approved-status filter combines with required transaction dates and an optional exact GL account code. Uses each line's division; debit, credit and currency are separate. No balances or totals are calculated.
Organisation-wide master report including unused GL accounts. Demonstrates type labels and a boolean field. A division-scoped report grant is still required to run it.

Organisation-wide Resource list, including unassigned Resources. A permanent boolean active filter combines with optional name search; underlying Resource-directory permission is not required when this report is granted.

One row per property Resource assignment, scoped by the property's owner division. Demonstrates controlled resource/role name relationships and optional role-code filtering. All saved assignment periods are shown.
